fixedAtChangelog.note: Moved fixedAt to on or after documentFirstCommittedAt while remaining before repurchase results are read.
Set fixedAt to the time of the commit that publishes it, still before any S1-3 results are read. Values between these two rows were only on an unpublished branch.

minSampleRationale: Minimum settled rows per resource endpoint before a delivery hit rate point may be published for that endpoint under S1-2. Operational floor for pre-registered measurement, not V4 section 6.C accuracy marketing figures.

timeSplit.note: Train on ledger rows whose attempted_at UTC date is on or before trainEndUtcDate. Evaluate on rows on or after evalStartUtcDate. V4 section 6.C used 2026-10-09 as the eval boundary.
